workflow: Chromium /d/local runs preselection and postselection, numeric factor, numeric/one-point/two-point Reference inputs, preview, Copy, coordinate-as-factor and non-positive rejection, factor-one undo-marker parity, mixed locked-layer handling and production DXF downloads; it then seeds the full fourteen-object IndexedDB fixture, commits twelve SCALE results in one operation, performs one UNDO and reloads revision 2.
result: All twelve supported families retained exact handles and properties while geometric sizes changed by two, Copy used fresh global handles, and locked/proxy rejects came from runtime data. Factor one created a persisted SCALE undo marker and one UNDO consumed it without undoing the preceding LINE. The full matrix restored atomically, IndexedDB reload and DXF readback matched, overflow/collapse and invalid inputs were rejected, and Chromium reported no page or console errors.
